description: Department of Labour - Order under Wages Boards Ordinance that the Cost of Living Index being 118.6 for the month of December, special allowance will be Rs. 677.71 in the month of January, 2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper trade, determined by the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector service conditions and benefits, specifically addressing wage adjustments for workers in a specific trade, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
